note: North Red Hills is the campground on a peninsula on the northwest side of Seminoe Reservoir, about 34 mi north of Sinclair via County Road 351, among red rock bluffs with no shade. The pads on the north side of the loop sit on open ground a short walk above the high-water line. Boat ramp at the campground. South Red Hills and Sunshine Beach are the park's other campgrounds. --Claude
